name: asciiloom
description: README-focused image-to-ASCII CLI with text, Markdown, and accessible SVG output.
author: AsciiLoom contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:cli
scripts.clean:cli: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist-cli', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:cli:built: vitest run tests/cli-integration.test.ts && npm run verify:examples:built
scripts.test:cli: npm run build:cli && npm run test:cli:built && npm run verify:package
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src tests e2e scripts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify:examples: npm run build:cli && npm run verify:examples:built
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.vite.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run check:lockfile && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:built && npm run test:cli:built && npm run verify:package
scripts.examples: npm run build:cli && node dist-cli/cli.js examples/demo-source.png --preset readme --format all --output examples/demo
